script_text: Stop! Aquarius, Saturn is forming a tense square to Uranus in your 8th House of Shared Resources, forcing you to confront hidden debts and transform rigid structures through sudden revelation. Mercury forms a challenging aspect to your ruling planet Uranus in the 9th House of Higher Learning, bringing abrupt intellectual breakthroughs and urgent communication needs. In love, expect a rare moment of profound connection as old patterns dissolve, inviting you to explore unconventional partnerships that honor your independent spirit. For career, the 10th House shows transformation opportunities as you shed outdated identities and embrace innovative leadership roles. Avoid clinging to familiar routines that no longer serve your growth; instead, trust the disruption as a catalyst for genuine progress. Subscribe so you don't miss what's coming this week.
